summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing that exchange-traded options on its subordinate voting shares will commence trading on the Montréal Exchange on July 13, 2026, under the symbol CURA. The listing is initiated solely by the exchange based on eligibility criteria; the company did not apply for it. No shares are issued, no dilution occurs, and no proceeds accrue to the company. This is a routine market development milestone, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or risk-arb angles apply.
